result.question: Why does Micah think Yahweh favors him?

readings.answer: Because a Levite has become his priest.
readings.support: because a Levite has become my priest.

assessments.reason: Micah explicitly says, “because a Levite has become my priest,” which directly matches having a Levite priest as his reason.

result.reason: The text states plainly that Micah expects the LORD’s favor because a Levite became his priest.
